headline: Nasdaq 100 Drops 6.7% in October on Rising AI Spending Concerns
summary: Fears that artificial intelligence investments will fail to generate sufficient returns drove the Nasdaq 100 down 6.7% in October, heavily impacting South Korea's chip-heavy equities.
why: High valuations in technology stocks tied to capital-intensive AI infrastructure make the sector sensitive to shifts in projected return on investment and spending sustainability.
why_moved: Growing skepticism regarding the financial returns on heavy AI investments triggered a sell-off across major technology equities.
